entry.hypothesis: H6 - the ETFs with the highest trailing 12-month distribution yield earn higher total returns; holding the top N equal-weighted beats owning the universe.
entry.rationale: Carry (Koijen-Moskowitz-Pedersen-Vrugt 2018) - the return if prices do not change predicts returns across asset classes because prices do not fully offset yield differences; for an ETF carry is its distribution yield, recovered from total-return vs price closes.

stopped_names.rule: D07: a holding is sold at the close of its last stored print; no open is fabricated
